name: Ceramic Materials
summary: Covers the structure, defects, mechanical behaviour and applications of traditional and advanced engineering ceramics.

topics.name: Ceramic crystal structures and defect chemistry revisited
Oxide ceramics: alumina, zirconia, magnesia, silica
Non-oxide ceramics: silicon carbide, silicon nitride, boron carbide, aluminium nitride
Mechanical behaviour: brittleness, flaw sensitivity and Weibull statistics
Toughening mechanisms: transformation toughening (zirconia), crack deflection, bridging
Ultra-high-temperature ceramics: ZrB2, HfB2, HfC and TaC
Electroceramics overview: dielectrics, piezoceramics, ionic conductors, ferrites
Bioceramics: alumina, zirconia, hydroxyapatite and bioactive glass
Carbon materials: graphite, carbon fibres, diamond and DLC
Ceramic processing overview (treated in depth under powder processing)
Design with brittle materials: proof testing and probabilistic design
